_about: Reviewed Strong's assignments where the lemma is a homograph in Strong's, or where MorphGNT's lemma spelling is not the one Strong's uses and the automatic spelling check cannot confirm Abbott-Smith's number. Each override is applied before any automatic match; the build fails if one is not honoured. Reviewed 2026-09-18 against the corpus occurrences and the Strong's headwords.

σύνειμι.why: Strong's has two σύνειμι: G4895 'be with' (εἰμί) and G4896 'come together' (εἶμι). MorphGNT uses one lemma; the occurrences (Luke 9:18, Acts 22:11; Luke 8:4 is the other verb) are read as G4895 per review.

εἶμι.why: "to go" (a genuinely different verb from εἰμί "to be", appearing only in the Septuagint here). Strong's Greek Dictionary never heads it on its own — only as a component of compound entries like σύνειμι above — so there is no correct Strong's number to assign; without this override the automatic match's accent-insensitive comparison would wrongly collide it with εἰμί's G1510.

βάτος.why: G942 bramble (Luke 6:44, 20:37, Mark 12:26, Acts 7:30, 35) vs G943 the liquid measure bath (Luke 16:6 only); the lemma is glossed as the bramble.

ῥέω.why: G4482 'flow' (John 7:38); G4483 is the suppletive 'say' (ἐρρέθη), which MorphGNT lemmatises separately.

Ζηλωτής.why: Capitalised: the Zealot (Simon), G2208; the common noun zealot is G2207.

ἄρχω.why: MorphGNT lemma is the active ἄρχω (G757); G756 is Strong's middle ἄρχομαι.

οἶδα.why: Strong's heads the perfect οἶδα under εἴδω.

ἀνεκτός.why: Strong's heads it by its comparative ἀνεκτότερος.

ἐπικαλέω.why: Strong's heads it as the middle ἐπικαλέομαι.

ἐμπίμπρημι.why: Strong's spelling ἐμπρήθω, the same verb (Matt 22:7).

πίμπλημι.why: Strong's spelling πλήθω, the same verb.

διαρρήγνυμι.why: Strong's spelling διαρρήσσω, the same verb.

ὠτάριον.why: Strong's heads the diminutive under ὠτίον.

εὖγε.why: Strong's has only εὖ; εὖγε (Luke 19:17) is its strengthened form.

ἐπιλέγω.why: Strong's heads it as the middle ἐπιλέγομαι.

ἔπειμι.why: Strong's heads it by its participle ἐπιοῦσα.

δεισιδαίμων.why: Strong's heads it by the comparative δεισιδαιμονέστερος (Acts 17:22).

διακούω.why: Strong's heads it as the middle διακούομαι.

ἀκριβής.why: Strong's heads it by the superlative ἀκριβέστατος (Acts 26:5).

Καῦδα.why: Strong's spelling Κλαύδη, the same island (Acts 27:16).

ἐκλανθάνω.why: Strong's heads it as the middle ἐκλανθάνομαι.

ἔοικα.why: Strong's heads the perfect ἔοικα under εἴκω.

ἀπογίνομαι.why: Strong's heads it by its participle ἀπογενόμενος (1 Pet 2:24).
